name: Ready Foods
old_description: With this vision, Ready Foods was founded to supply foodservice operators with quality recipes to be scaled with consistency. Soon after, the Marco's product line was created to provide restaurants with an economical way to serve authentic Mexican cuisine on their menu, based on Luis Abarca’s heritage. Although we have grown from our original kitchen on Colfax Avenue, the Abarca's philosophy continues to provide a vision for Ready Foods over fifty years later. Through years of expansion to our current multi-facility production space, we stand by the integrity of our food, our collective knowledge and the expertise of our workforce.
about:
Ready Foods was founded in 1972 by immigrant Luis Abarca in Denver, Colorado. The family-owned company began as a small kitchen on Colfax Avenue, aiming to provide foodservice operators with consistent, scalable recipes. Soon after, the Marco's product line was launched to offer authentic Mexican cuisine based on Abarca's heritage. Today, the Abarca family still leads the business, which has expanded into a multi-facility operation.

The company operates as a custom food purveyor and private-label co-packer, producing ready-to-use sauces, soups, salsas, beans, tamales, and tortillas. Its production footprint includes five plants totaling over 200,000 square feet: the San Marco's building (8,000 sq ft), Salsa Plant (23,000 sq ft), Bean Plant (33,000 sq ft), Dahlia Plant (80,000 sq ft), and 42nd Street Plant (63,000 sq ft). An in-house R&D team develops custom formulations, and products are packaged in five-pound bags with a six-month frozen shelf life. The workforce numbers around 100 employees.

Ready Foods serves independent and chain restaurants, national and regional accounts, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, caterers, hotels, and event venues. Its products reach customers through major broadline distributors. The company also supports foodservice operators facing labor shortages by providing consistent, ready-to-heat items that reduce prep time.

The founder's original vision was to solve labor-driven inconsistency in commercial kitchens as diverse cuisines became mainstream. Ready Foods emphasizes a glass-free facility, paperless quality assurance, and BRC-certified food safety. Its mission stresses safe, high-quality food, employee-centered culture, and community impact, while its vision focuses on empowering customers and teams through delicious recipes.
